title: Graduate Insights Analyst
description: Soho, London Hybrid working: 3 days in the office Tues - Thurs The Role The Marketing Insights team is an integral department within LiveScore Group and the Casino Marketing Insights team is looking to expand to support the growth of the Casino vertical. As a Casino Graduate Insights Analyst, you will work with multiple teams and stakeholders, across many areas of the business, to optimise market share, highlight opportunities and trends, all helping to create a thrilling experience for our Casino customers. With an abundance of data to work with, our analysts use a range of analytical tools, to provide senior leaders in the business with actionable recommendations that drive business decisions. At LiveScore Group, we're the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We're proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan's passion for sport driving us to the top. We don't just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it's our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you're good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users. We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you're passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you! Key Responsibilities Collaborate with the wider Insights team to analyse data and communicate recommendations that support LiveScore Casino's growth. Support the analysis of customer, transactional and game-level data using SQL to help the business better understand user behaviour, identify trends and solve real-world business challenges. Regularly monitor core Casino product KPIs, proactively investigating changes in performance and understanding the drivers behind those changes. Build an understanding of the business needs to ensure analytical requests are met with accurate, relevant data. Interpret and translate findings into a coherent story, using engaging visual summaries and presentations to aid in influencing business decisions. Maintain open and continuous communications with your manager and your team with regards to workload and projects. Skills, Knowledge and Experience Excellent analytical and numerical capabilities . Ideally developed through a degree in a quantitative field . Experience using SQL in an academic or professional setting, with a strong desire to rapidly develop these hands-on technical skills in a real business environment. An understanding of the betting and gaming industry is strongly preferred. Ability to turn data into actionable recommendations and confidently present analysis . Self-motivated with the desire to find and solve business problems. Ability to learn in a fast-changing work environment. Ability to communicate confidently and coherently, including verbal and written presentation skills. Ability to build good working relationships with stakeholders and other teams within the business. An understand of marketing metrics (such as acquisition costs, customer retention or promotional campaigns) preferred but not required. A highly collaborative mindset and a firm believer in teamwork & collaboration. What can we offer? Company Performance Bonus Flexible Working Agreements where applicable Private Healthcare Scheme + Employee Enhanced Assistance Enhanced Family Leave - Maternity, Shared Parental & Adoption Leave: up to 6 months at full pay and 6 months at half pay. You will lead architectural discussions, own the design of business-critical data solutions and deliver high-quality systems that bring millions of fans closer to the sports they love. This is a fantastic opportunity to lead the optimisation of our data platforms for real-time AI/ML workloads, mentor engineers and make a significant impact on our business. The Senior Data Engineer leads technical initiatives, maintains data integrity and performance, and works across teams to translate complex business requirements into effective data solutions. The role also uses automation and artificial intelligence to improve efficiency, decision-making and productivity across the organisation. At LiveScore Group, we're the proud home of three of the most exciting brands in the sports and gaming world: LiveScore, LiveScore Bet and Virgin Bet. A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We're proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan's passion for sport driving us to the top. We don't just lead; we innovate. Our cutting-edge products and immersive experiences set the standard, but it's our people who truly make the difference. Every day, our team embody our values: adaptability, teamwork, a fan-driven approach, and an ever-curious mindset that fuels our ambition. As we scale and continue to create a culture that allows all employees to thrive, we know we need the most talented people with diverse backgrounds, perspectives and skills. If you're good at what you do, come and join us. The more inclusive we are, the more amazing experiences we can create for our users. We know that job descriptions can sometimes seem daunting, and you might not feel you tick every box. But, if you're passionate about the role and have relevant experience, we want to hear from you! Key Responsibilities Lead the design and delivery of robust data pipelines using GCP services such as BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage. This includes integrating data from various sources, ensuring data quality and enabling real-time processing capabilities. Own the design of data models and databases that support business analytics and intelligence, using dimensional data-modelling principles. Select and use GCP database technologies such as Bigtable, Spanner or Firestore to optimise performance and scalability. Lead the automation of data workflows and optimisation of data storage and processing costs within GCP. Use tools such as Cloud Composer for orchestration and establish best practices in performance tuning. Ensure data security by implementing GCP security practices. Manage access controls, comply with data-governance policies and safeguard sensitive information. Work closely with data engineers, business analysts and IT teams to define data requirements and deliver comprehensive data solutions. Provide technical leadership and guidance to team members. Evaluate new GCP features and data-engineering technologies, setting technical direction where they can enhance data infrastructure or enable new data products. Lead the resolution of critical pipeline failures and data-quality incidents, performing fault analysis and ensuring that preventative improvements are implemented. Lead critical system-design and architectural decisions for scalable batch and real-time workloads. Partner with cross-functional teams to translate complex or ambiguous business needs into effective and innovative data solutions. Mentor engineers, review technical designs and foster a culture of continuous learning and engineering excellence. Own improvements to the reliability, performance and cost-effectiveness of data systems. Lead the design and maintenance of robust, secure integrations with core internal systems and critical third-party platforms. Define appropriate monitoring and alerting standards to ensure high system reliability and minimal downtime. Skills, Knowledge and Experience Significant experience in data engineering or data warehousing with large-scale, complex datasets. Advanced SQL and Python skills, with experience using AI-assisted development tools appropriately. Strong knowledge of data-modelling techniques. Deep experience with cloud data services and technologies, ideally within the GCP ecosystem, such as Dataflow, Pub/Sub, BigQuery or Vertex AI. Proven experience designing and implementing robust ELT pipelines, including real-time and large-scale batch processing. Proven ability to deploy and maintain data infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code principles and tools such as Terraform. Experience with Airflow environment management and Docker. Experience contributing to an AI roadmap and evaluating AI tooling, including coding agents, for use within the development lifecycle. The ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrable experience applying data-governance, privacy and security best practices in a regulated environment. A proactive and curious approach, with the ability to anticipate and resolve system inefficiencies. The ability to lead cross-functional technical work and translate complex or ambiguous requirements into robust data solutions. A track record of taking end-to-end ownership for the quality, reliability and performance of business-critical data solutions. Experience mentoring engineers and influencing technical standards across a team. What can we offer? title: Staff Engineer - Telematics
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role At Samsara, we're looking for a hands-on Staff Software Engineer to help turn growing Telematics products into major businesses. Our new product bets include routing and workforce management for physical operations. The portfolio has paying customers and early traction. You'll help shape what comes next, working directly with customers to understand their operations, test ideas and build solutions they choose to use. You'll stay close to the work through production, customer adoption and scale. This is a technical leadership role with substantial hands-on engineering. You'll define important problems and make product and technical decisions alongside Product, Design and Engineering partners. You'll bring the judgement to move forward when requirements are incomplete, and the influence to align other teams around a clear direction. What you will do Work directly with customers and customer-facing teams to understand unmet needs, test assumptions and identify opportunities worth pursuing. Agree on success measures with Product and Design before investing in a solution. Lead ambiguous initiatives end to end, from discovery and prototypes through production rollout, adoption and iteration. Use customer feedback and product data to decide what to improve, expand or stop. Write and ship code on the critical path. Work across services, APIs and customer-facing experiences as the problem requires, combining technical depth with the ability to learn unfamiliar parts of the product. Set technical direction for your area and align the teams needed to deliver it. Make pragmatic architecture choices that support rapid learning today and reliable growth over time. Own the production quality of what you build. Design for correctness, reliability and performance, plan safe rollouts, and use operational evidence to address the constraints that emerge as usage grows. Increase the effectiveness of the engineers around you through design and code reviews, mentoring senior engineers, and removing recurring obstacles to delivery. Share context and decisions so others can move independently. About the role: In this role, you will: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team What you will bring A track record of shipping customer-facing products and growing them beyond their initial launch. You can explain your contribution to measurable outcomes such as adoption, revenue growth, retention, customer efficiency or cost to serve. Strong product judgement. You have worked directly with customers, clarified poorly defined problems and made decisions using evidence, including changing direction when an initial idea did not work. Deep hands-on software engineering ability, with recent experience designing, implementing and operating production systems. You can move from a prototype to maintainable software and explain the trade-offs along the way. Experience scaling products and the systems behind them. You know how to identify the next constraint, balance speed with reliability, and make technical investments that support customer and business growth. Technical leadership across team boundaries. You have built alignment without formal authority, made other engineers more effective, and communicated difficult choices clearly to technical and business partners. Experience that could be useful Experience building B2B software through an early growth stage, or working on routing, workforce management or other software for physical operations. We value evidence of learning a complex customer domain and delivering results; previous industry experience is helpful, rather than essential. What success looks like Customers adopt the capabilities you help build and can see the benefit in their day-to-day operations. The products remain dependable as usage grows. Your technical decisions support measurable business progress, and the teams around you can deliver more effectively because of your work. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu , a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here . description: <div> <div><strong>Who Connecteam is:</strong><br>Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide. We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesn’t happen behind a desk, and doesn’t have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that don’t talk to each other. Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job. Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency.</div> <div><br><strong>About The Role:</strong><br>Do you know those people who get a great career opportunity at the perfect time and change their lives? Now it’s your chance to be one of them!<br>If you are looking for a challenging role that includes sales, products, and business development Then look no further!<br>As the face of Connecteam and the first point of contact with our customers, you will have a direct influence on our development and expansion! Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future. If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you. The Role KIRA is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading. These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges. The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch. We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted. Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements. What We're Looking For 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production. Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems. Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs. Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain. Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints. Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used. Nice to have Engineering or highly technical product background. Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products. Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products. Outcome Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction Location This is a hybrid role . You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week , with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely. title: Management Accountant
description: Management Accountant 🌟 Position: Management Accountant (Qualified / Nearly Qualified) 📍 Location: Hybrid – London office and home working 💼 Type: Full-time 📅 Start Date: Immediate 💰 Salary: £45k to £60k About Cooper Moss Rutland Cooper Moss Rutland (CMR) is an independent, award-winning project controls consultancy supporting some of the UK's most complex construction and infrastructure programmes. We provide specialist expertise across project controls, planning, cost, risk, change, reporting and data, working across rail, highways, aviation, defence, nuclear, energy and water. We are a growing business with an ambitious outlook. Our culture is collaborative, entrepreneurial and focused on delivering high-quality work for our clients, while creating an environment where our people can develop and make a genuine impact. The Role We are looking for a Management Accountant to take ownership of the core financial processes that underpin our growing business. This is a hands-on role covering the mechanics of our finance function: month-end close, accruals, reconciliations, VAT, the timesheet-to-invoice process and the production of accurate, timely management accounts. You would be joining a function that has grown quickly and has room to improve. We want someone who will run the core processes reliably and then make them better, rather than accepting them as they are. You would be the in-house finance lead, working with our external accountants and, where needed, senior finance support. This would suit someone who is qualified or nearly qualified , has strong technical accounting fundamentals and enjoys being close to the detail while also understanding the wider commercial picture. Key Responsibilities Month-End & Management Accounts Own and manage the month-end close process from start to finish. Prepare accurate and timely monthly management accounts. Prepare and post month-end journals, including accruals, prepayments and other adjustments. Reconcile balance sheet accounts and investigate and resolve discrepancies. Provide clear financial information and commentary to the leadership team. Prepare monthly cash flow forecasts and support the annual budgeting cycle. Revenue, Billing & WIP Own the timesheet-to-invoice process, from approved timesheets through to invoices issued. Raise client invoices in line with each client's billing arrangements, which vary considerably by client and by platform. Maintain revenue accruals and monitor unbilled work, keeping WIP and the cash conversion cycle under control. Run credit control and follow up overdue balances. Monitor timesheet submissions and chase employees for missing or incomplete timesheets ahead of each month-end. Accounts Payable, Payments & Cash Manage the accounts payable process, ensuring supplier invoices are accurately recorded and appropriately authorised. Maintain accurate supplier records and resolve supplier queries and invoice discrepancies. Process employee expenses and company credit card transactions, checking them against policy and chasing missing receipts. Prepare and process supplier payment runs. Support cash flow management and ensure key payment obligations are met on time. VAT & Compliance Prepare and submit VAT returns accurately and on time. Ensure VAT treatment is applied correctly across transactions. Support the year-end accounts process and CMR's external accountants. Work with the external accountants (and any fractional senior finance support) on year-end, tax and technical accounting matters, escalating judgement calls rather than deciding them alone. Financial Control & Reporting Perform regular bank, control account and balance sheet reconciliations. Identify errors, inconsistencies and control issues and take ownership of resolving them. Support the development and maintenance of appropriate financial controls and processes. What We're Looking For Essential Qualified or nearly qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent). Strong understanding of accounting fundamentals and double-entry bookkeeping. Practical experience of month-end accounting and preparation of management accounts. Experience with accruals, prepayments, journals and balance sheet reconciliations. Experience preparing or supporting VAT returns. Strong Excel skills and experience with Xero or a similar accounting system. A proactive approach, with the confidence to investigate issues rather than simply flagging them. At least two years' experience working in industry rather than solely in practice. Experience of timesheet-based, multi-client billing and credit control. Experience working as the sole or lead finance person, or the confidence to do so. Desirable Experience within professional services, consultancy, construction or another project-based business. Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting and cash flow reporting. Previous experience working in a growing SME environment. The Person We're looking for someone who is hands-on, organised and commercially aware . You'll be comfortable getting into the detail, but you won't lose sight of the bigger picture. You will take pride in getting the numbers right, meeting deadlines and maintaining a finance function that the wider business can rely on. You'll be comfortable in a growing business where not everything is perfectly established, and willing to say when something isn't working rather than quietly working around it. Most importantly, you'll be someone people can trust with the numbers. What You'll Get at CMR The opportunity to play a key role in the finance function of a growing consultancy. Exposure to the wider commercial and operational side of the business. Support for your continued professional development and qualification. A flexible/hybrid working environment. About You If you're a qualified or nearly qualified accountant looking for a role where you can take genuine ownership, work closely with senior stakeholders and play an important part in a growing business, we'd love to hear from you. Come and help us build the finance function that supports the next stage of Cooper Moss Rutland's growth. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Finance Manager / Financial Controller
description: 🌟 Position: Finance Manager / Financial Controller 📍 Location: Hybrid – London office and home working 💼 Type: Part-time 📅 Start Date: Immediate 💰 Salary: £50k to 85K DOE About Cooper Moss Rutland Cooper Moss Rutland (CMR) is an independent, award-winning Project Controls consultancy specialising in helping clients overcome complex challenges across major construction and infrastructure programmes. Our expertise spans planning and scheduling, cost, risk, change, reporting and data, and we work on some of the UK's most complex programmes across rail, nuclear, defence, energy, aviation and water. As the business continues to grow, we are looking for an experienced Finance Manager / Financial Controller to take ownership of the finance function and play a key role in supporting the continued development of the business. The Opportunity This is a key appointment and a chance to take genuine ownership of the finance function in a growing consultancy. We are looking for someone who can bring structure, control and insight to the business while staying comfortable in a hands-on environment. Depending on experience, the role could sit at Finance Manager or Financial Controller level. This is a part-time role, typically two to three days a week, with fixed days agreed in advance and including the month-end close. At Finance Manager level, you would own the day-to-day finance function, month-end close, management reporting, budgeting, forecasting and cash flow. At Financial Controller level, you would take broader responsibility for the control environment, processes and the external accountant relationship, with junior support handling the transactional workload. This is not simply a reporting role. We are looking for someone who can build and improve the finance function as CMR continues to scale . Key Responsibilities Financial Management & Reporting Own the month-end close process from end to end. Prepare accurate and timely monthly management accounts and reporting packs. Present the monthly numbers to the Partners with clear commentary, flagging what matters and what does not. Monitor business performance against budget, forecast and prior periods. Bring the month-end close timetable down and hold it there, so the Partners have management information early in the following month rather than at the end of it. Track actuals against budget and forecast each month, and investigate the variances rather than simply reporting them. Run a monthly finance meeting with the Partners, setting the agenda for what they should be looking at and where the business needs to pay attention. Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Lead the annual budgeting and planning cycle. Develop and maintain rolling cash flow forecasts. Manage reforecasting and scenario analysis to support decisions on hiring, new clients and investment. Controls and Process Own CMR's financial control environment, along with the finance policies and procedures behind it. Identify opportunities to automate and streamline finance processes, particularly the timesheet, invoicing and reporting chain, and shape how finance works with CMR's wider business systems. Ensure appropriate controls are in place across revenue, expenditure, purchasing, payments, cash and reporting. Own VAT compliance, including review and submission of VAT returns and ensuring the correct VAT treatment is applied across transactions. Year End and External Accountants Coordinate the preparation of statutory accounts. Manage the relationship with CMR's external accountants. Coordinate year-end activities, and help prepare the business for statutory audit as CMR approaches the turnover threshold. Transactional Finance Oversee day-to-day transactional finance: purchase and sales ledger, invoicing, expenses, credit cards, payments, bank reconciliations and the timesheet-to-invoice process. Take ownership of client billing, which varies considerably by client and by platform, along with unbilled work and revenue accruals. Supervise, review and develop the Finance Assistant, who runs the day-to-day purchase ledger, sales invoicing, reconciliations, expenses and timesheet chasing. Oversee credit control and cash collection, including the debtor position and follow-up of overdue balances. Agree clear escalation routes with the Finance Assistant and the Partners for urgent queries and approvals on the days you are not working. At Finance Manager level, remain comfortable being hands-on with transactional finance where required. At Financial Controller level, provide appropriate oversight while using junior finance support to manage the transactional workload. What We're Looking For Essential ACA, ACCA or CIMA qualified with at least two to three years post-qualification experience, or strong equivalent experience. Strong experience across month-end, management accounts and financial reporting. Experience owning budgets, forecasts and cash flow. A background in industry rather than practice. We are not looking for someone moving straight from an accountancy firm. Comfortable being hands-on. This is a small finance function, but day-to-day transactional processing is handled by the Finance Assistant. Experience improving finance processes, systems and controls. Strong Excel skills and experience with Xero or a similar accounting system. The ability to explain financial information clearly to non-finance colleagues, and the confidence to challenge them on it. Experience running a disciplined month-end timetable, and a track record of improving reporting turnaround. Experience acting as a sounding board to non-finance business owners, guiding what they should be looking at rather than waiting to be asked. Experience supervising or mentoring junior finance staff. Comfortable working a fixed part-time pattern, with clear priorities and handovers between working days. Desirable Experience within professional services, consultancy, construction or another project-based business. Experience preparing a business for its first statutory audit. The Person The successful candidate will be someone who wants to take ownership rather than simply manage a process . You will be comfortable getting into the detail when required, but equally able to step back and provide the leadership team with clear financial insight and challenge. Why Join CMR? Join a growing, independent consultancy operating across the UK and internationally. Have genuine ownership and influence over the finance function. Work directly with the Partners and senior leadership team. Join a collaborative, people-focused culture built around innovation, development and continuous improvement. title: Principal Software Engineer
description: Life at UiPath The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power. To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose. Could that be you? Your mission UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale. Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance. It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job. You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets. What you'll do at UiPath Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products. Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working. Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't. Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads. Build for environments we don't control: multi-cloud, on-premises, air-gapped, and under strict security and compliance requirements. Use coding agents as a serious part of your toolkit, and help the team get better at it. Where to trust them, where not to, and how to keep quality high as the tooling changes underneath us. Work with teams across UiPath and across locations to innovate and build best-in-class document processing, and occasionally with customers directly. Because the fastest way to understand a product is to watch someone use it. Contribute to our engineering culture: mentor, review, hire, and push back when something isn't good enough. What you'll bring to the team A solid track record (7+ years) building and operating large-scale commercial services that real customers depend on. Strong programming ability and the confidence to pick up whatever language a problem calls for. You'll meet Python, Rust and C# here, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing them all. Real-world experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and containerised deployment on Kubernetes. You understand how production systems get shipped, monitored and scaled, not just written. Comfort with data at scale: SQL, and the trade-offs between different storage and search systems. Experience working with coding agents, and opinions about them, What responsible use looks like, where they earn their keep and where they cost you, and how you keep evaluating them in an ecosystem that changes every few months. An appreciation for tools that catch bugs before runtime — type systems, tests, and designs that make bad states unrepresentable. Especially in the age of coding agents. A pragmatic grasp of computer science fundamentals. We care about solving real problems with the right data structure, not reciting one from a textbook. Experience shipping LLM-backed products to production is a strong plus: prompting, evaluation, and everything else that turns a model into a feature people will trust. Familiarity with document processing is a plus: OCR, layout, and the messy reality of documents as they actually arrive. An opinion on what makes good code and good architecture, and the ability to argue it, including against us. You're a builder and a problem-solver at heart. Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned. Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected. We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy . title: Data Scientist - iwocaPay Credit Risk Modelling
description: Data Scientist - iwocaPay Credit Risk Modelling Hybrid in London, United Kingdom (one day per week in office requirement) We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the iwocaPay Risk Squad. You'll own credit models that decide who iwocaPay can safely fund, on what terms, and how far the product can grow. You'll help shape how risk modelling develops. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team The Risk Squad owns credit risk and fraud for iwocaPay, iwoca's Buy Now Pay Later product for businesses. The aim is to lend to every business likely to repay, and to spot the ones that aren't. The squad works across three areas: Lending decisions. Building and improving the automated credit model. The portfolio. Tracking losses, chargebacks, and seller performance, and deciding which segments to grow or pull back from. New products. Designing the risk side of each one before it launches. The squad is small and new – two data scientists, a risk analyst and a risk lead. The role As a Data Scientist in the Risk Squad, you'll co-own every credit model with the other data scientist and review one another's work. The job is mostly supervised ML on tabular data, with a fair amount of data engineering as the squad moves onto its own pipelines. You'll start on the automated credit model and take on the invoice financing models over time. You can also test ideas with iwoca's other lending data science teams, who work on similar credit problems. You'll choose what to work on and write the plans you deliver. Much of the squad's work happens in iwocaPay's product and strategy meetings, so your models shape the roadmap. You'll also help set up how the squad works – what it monitors, and the guidelines it follows. Live project examples: Model architecture. Rethinking the model around how iwocaPay actually lends: overlapping facilities, short terms, and a growing set of products a customer can use. Blending datasets. Bringing more iwocaPay-specific data into the models while still drawing on iwoca's larger core lending dataset, through methods such as transfer learning. Invoice financing. Building a credit risk model from scratch for a new product on a segment iwoca hasn’t lent to before. Plus finding the modelling opportunities elsewhere in the funnel, like in our offers... The requirements Essential: Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field – typically a degree or Master's in Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, or similar. You reason about uncertainty and calibration as first-order concerns. Production ML. You have built supervised ML models on tabular data end to end – exploration, training, deployment, and monitoring. Ownership. You work well in a small, early-stage team where priorities move quickly. You build what you need as you go, and take loosely defined problems from framing to a landed decision. Judgement. You know when a model is good enough to go live, and when it needs more work. You critically evaluate model output – yours, a colleague's, or an LLM's – and can explain why a choice is right. AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – a modelling pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in product, risk, and leadership. Bonus: Domain experience. You have worked in credit risk modelling or lending. Non-linear methods. You have used gradient boosting or neural networks on tabular data in production. Combining datasets. You have used transfer learning, domain adaptation, or similar methods on data sources of different size and relevance. Data engineering. You have built data pipelines and managed datasets alongside your modelling work. Coding. You can write code for analysis. The squad works in Python. The salary We expect to pay from £60,000 to £80,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse. title: Senior Business Operations Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><h2><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></h2> <p>The Chief Business Officer organization drives company-wide growth and global expansion. </p> <p>This is the role that turns Airbnb's ambition for the UKI & Nordics into a plan and holds the organisation to delivering it: shaping strategy, aligning cross-functional teams, and driving sustainable commercial growth across one of our most important regions.</p> <p>This includes recruiting and supporting high-quality Stays, Experiences, and Services, alongside executing Airbnb’s global market strategy. Shaping business approaches, quality supply sourcing, and international growth efforts are integral to the team’s success in connecting millions more hosts and guests to Airbnb's platform.</p> <h2><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></h2> <p>You will join the UKI, Nordics, Middle East and Africa team, covering one of Airbnb’s largest and most mature markets alongside five of Europe’s most digitally advanced, high-trust travel markets. The UK offers scale, brand strength, and a sophisticated regulatory environment; the Nordics offer strong domestic travel behaviour and significant headroom for growth. Together they make this one of the most commercially interesting regions in EMEA to build in.</p> <h2><strong>A Typical Day</strong></h2> <p>You will own the business operations agenda for the UKI and Nordics. Airbnb’s most established European market alongside five high-potential Nordic markets (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland). Partnering closely with the Country Manager, you will set the regional growth strategy, translate it into a plan cross-functional teams can execute against, and run the operating rhythm that keeps it on track. This is a high-visibility role: your influence will come from the quality of your thinking and your ability to mobilise teams to grow further.</p> <h3><strong>Regional growth strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the UKI & Nordics growth strategy end to end: define where the region should compete, what it should stop doing, and the handful of bets that will move guest nights, supply growth, and revenue.</li> <li>Build the annual and quarterly plan with the Country Manager, sizing opportunities and making explicit recommendations on where to deploy marketing spend, supply investment, and partnership effort.</li> <li>Set and pressure-test the region’s targets, translating global goals into market-level commitments that supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product teams can own.</li> <li>Run deep-dive analyses on demand and supply dynamics, competitive movements, pricing, and seasonality, turning each into a clear recommendation, not just a read-out.</li> <li>Identify and stand up new growth initiatives, using the UK as a test market for offerings that can then scale across EMEA, and the Nordics as a proving ground for high-penetration, low-friction market plays.</li> <li>Build the case for investment in the region: sizing, business case, and the socialisation needed to win resource in global planning cycles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Operating rhythm and execution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the region’s operating cadence: weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, so leadership has a single, trusted view of performance and the story behind it.</li> <li>Convert strategy into sequenced execution plans with named owners, milestones, and success measures across supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product.</li> <li>Track delivery against the plan, surfacing risks and bottlenecks early and driving them to resolution rather than escalating them.</li> <li>Design and continuously improve the operating processes the region runs on, raising the bar on efficiency, transparency, and decision speed.</li> <li>Lead the region’s input into global planning and resource allocation cycles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Cross-functional leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the connective tissue between the UKI & Nordics team and global functions such as Product, Marketing, Communications, Policy, Finance, Data Science, Legal, and Community Support.</li> <li>Be the go-to decision partner alongside the Country Manager: the person other teams come to for the region’s position, context, and priorities.</li> <li>Build alignment on high-priority projects, market launches, and product tests, brokering trade-offs between global consistency and local market reality.</li> <li>Represent UKI & Nordics in NEMEA and global business operations forums, and bring the best of what other markets are doing back into the region.</li> <li>Partner with Public Policy on the regulatory landscape, including short-term let rules in the UKI and Nordic city regulation so commercial plans account for policy risk and opportunity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Insights and storytelling</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Turn complex data into clear narratives that help leadership decide with a recommendation attached.</li> <li>Build the reporting layer the region relies on: dashboards, performance packs, and executive materials, working with a dedicated analyst.</li> <li>Establish the metrics that matter for the region and hold the team to a shared definition of success.</li> <li>Champion data-driven decision-making, and use AI tooling to compress the time from question to insight. Automating recurring analysis and reporting so the team spends its time on judgement, not assembly.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your Expertise</strong></h2> <p>To deliver in this role, Airbnb is seeking candidates with:</p> <ul> <li>12+ years in business operations, strategy, consulting, or commercial leadership, with a track record of owning outcomes in a market or business unit</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to set strategy and drive it through to execution </li> <li>Deep experience influencing without authority across a global matrixed organisation</li> <li>Strong analytical toolkit; comfortable working with finance and data science partners and interrogating the numbers yourself</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication, with executive presence in front of senior leadership</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, and a strong bias toward action and ownership</li> <li>Practical fluency with AI tools and a view on where they change how a team operates</li> <li>Familiarity with the UKI and/or Nordic markets, or comparable mature-market experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Additional</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in a two-sided marketplace, travel/hospitality, or consumer tech</li> <li>Experience launching or scaling new products or lines of business in-market</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>This role will require to be in the London office 3 days per week. </strong></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">United Kingdom Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£126,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£158,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - AI
description: About Flow Flow Engineering is an AI-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor. About the role Flow is seeking software engineers to build AI-powered capabilities that help teams author, review, and manage requirements more effectively. You will work on agentic systems engineer and agentic domain engineer workflows—bringing AI into the center of how teams reason about their systems.​ This role sits at the intersection of AI, product, and full-stack engineering: you will take ideas from prototype all the way to stable, observable features in production.​ What you’ll do Design and ship AI-powered features such as assisted requirement drafting, consistency checks, impact analysis, and intelligent suggestions for systems and domain engineers. Build agentic workflows that help “agentic systems engineers” and “agentic domain engineers” explore designs, simulate changes, and validate requirements.​ Evaluate and integrate language models and related tooling, optimizing for reliability, latency, cost, and debuggability in production. title: Research Scientist - Control & Machine Learning
description: At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution. We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints. With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge? Research questions you could initially work on Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control? Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected? Learning while controlling. How can we use dual control and active learning to choose actions that improve performance while gathering information about uncertain dynamics? Learning across plants. Which parts of a model or control strategy can transfer between plants, and how can we adapt them efficiently to a new site? These are meant as examples rather than an exhaustive list. We’re looking for someone who can bring depth to a relevant area, identify promising connections, and help us decide which problems to tackle next. Your main responsibilities As a Research Scientist, you’ll: Help shape our research and development agenda, turning challenges from live plants into well-defined research problems. Develop and implement methods for modelling, identification, optimisation and control of complex physical systems. Design rigorous experiments, establish strong baselines and understand when and why a method works. Work with process engineers to incorporate plant physics, operating knowledge and constraints into models and algorithms. Work with machine learning and deployment engineers to evaluate promising methods and bring them into production. Follow deployed performance, investigate failures, and use what you learn to guide further research. Communicate your findings clearly and contribute to the team’s scientific understanding. What a great fit looks like A PhD in control, machine learning, applied mathematics, engineering, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience. A strong research background in one or more of control theory, data-driven control, system identification, Bayesian optimisation, probabilistic modelling, physics-informed machine learning, imitation learning or model-based reinforcement learning . Evidence that you can formulate a research question, develop a method and evaluate it carefully, through publications, open-source work or applied research. Strong Python skills and experience implementing machine learning models using tools such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch. An interest in working closely with engineers and taking responsibility for how your methods perform in practice. Practical experience deploying machine learning and control algorithms. A strong interest in climate mitigation. You don’t need to know about cement. You do need to get excited about the physics, willing to learn from operators and process engineers, and keen to understand why a plant behaves the way it does. We don’t expect you to tick every box. If you bring depth in a relevant area and these problems excite you, we’d like to hear from you. In return for your hard work, we’ll give you 📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside. 🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team. 🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge 🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one. Our Operating Principles ↗️ Go Gig or Go Home : High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires. 🏭 Concrete Honesty : Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture. 🦾 Autonomous Ownership : High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it. 😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun : Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page. title: Senior eCommerce Content Strategist
description: About Us Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. We partner with brands including Panasonic, Reebok, Stokke, KIKO, Next, Twining's, Canon, Bondi Sands and Philips, helping them accelerate growth and deliver exceptional customer experiences across major marketplaces including Amazon and Zalando, branded webstores and social platforms. Backed by significant investment, Luzern is an international, technology-led eCommerce business with anambitious growth strategy. Our AI-enabled Channel Optimizer platform, combined with our eCommerce expertise, helps brands manage and grow their presence across increasingly complex digital channels. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are looking for talented people who enjoy working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to play an active role in the next stage of Luzern's development. The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C. The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption. A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms. The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility. Tasks What You’ll Be Doing Content Audits & Quality Assessment ● Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short. ● Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. ● Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy. Content Strategy Development ● Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus. ● Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour. ● Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category. ● Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on. ● Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction. AI & Agentic Discoverability ● AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search. ● Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations. ● Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery. Testing & Performance Monitoring ● A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent. ● Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation. ● Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy. Creative Briefing & Review ● Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and marketplace advertising content. ● Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction. ● Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery. Client Management ● Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders. ● Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams. ● Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements. ● Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice. ● Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business. Quality & Output Review ● Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements. ● Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy. AI-Enabled Working ● AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy. ● Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team. Requirements What You Bring to the Role ● Proven experience in Amazon content strategy and execution (listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store, Amazon Posts), ideally within an agency or managed services environment. ● Working knowledge of content requirements across at least one other marketplace or major retailer platform (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C. ● Experience running content audits — analysing reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries and customer/AI-agent queries — and scoring content quality (e.g. IDQ or equivalent) against best-in-Class standards. ● Experience translating audit findings into content strategy: comms objectives, key messaging, messaging hierarchy, and content requirements for imagery and copy. ● Experience developing or briefing A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups, working closely with designers. ● Experience designing and running A/B tests to determine the most effective executional approach, and setting up performance monitoring (e.g. Amazon Compass or equivalent) to track results. ● Strong understanding of how AI assistants and platform shopping agents (e.g. ChatGPT, Rufus)surface and rank product content, and how content should be structured to support this. ● Confident, credible client-facing communicator — comfortable presenting strategy, leading feedback conversations, and owning estimates and proposals. ● Experience briefing creative teams for paid social/display advertising, across both static and video formats. ● Demonstrable, hands-on use of AI tools for research, auditing and content production, not just familiarity in principle. ● Strong copywriting and content editing skills, with a close eye for brand and platform compliance. ● Comfortable reviewing and giving constructive feedback on the work of SEO and design peers. Desirable ● Experience across multiple international marketplaces or retail media platforms. ● Familiarity with SEO fundamentals, to collaborate effectively with the SEO Executive. ● Experience contributing to new business pitches or proposals. ● Category experience relevant to Luzern's enterprise brand client base. Benefits What We Offer ● Competitive salary and benefits ● Hybrid Working Model ● Great working environment with a passionate, collaborative team ● Continuous learning & career development ● The opportunity to work with some of the world's leading brands across the most exciting marketplaces We are committed to equal opportunities and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.
