We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. The Role Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a full-stack Product Engineer * to lead the inception and development of our internal application suite, serving as the foundational architect for the tools our world-class researchers use every day. *Note that you would be joining as a ‘Member of Technical Staff’, but the indicative job title above hopefully helps to explain the nature of this role. The role will be part of our Platform Engineering organisation. Your Impact In this role you will be building the internal product ecosystem that streamlines and curates our proprietary discovery workflows, which is critical for accelerating our mission to solve global challenges through next-generation materials. Your main focus initially will be partnering with our VP of Product to define and build the first generation of internal applications from scratch, ensuring they are not just functional but curated as high-quality products. Over time, you will likely get involved in scaling these systems to support increasingly complex interdisciplinary data flows and potentially external-facing interfaces as our "search engine" for materials evolves. What You Will Do Product Inception & Internal Tooling Lead the development of a suite of internal applications, treating them as first-class products with a focus on usability and long-term scalability. Collaborate closely with the VP of Product to translate high-level research needs into technical roadmaps and intuitive software solutions. Own the end-to-end lifecycle of internal tools, from initial architecture and backend design to frontend deployment. Full-Stack Development & Platform Integration Design and build robust backend services in Python to interface with our core AI and research engines, integrating disparate workflows into a unified, high-performance internal platform. Partner with the Data Engineering team to ensure seamless ingestion and visualisation of complex datasets within internal applications. Develop clean, responsive UIs that enable researchers to interact with complex data effectively, maintaining a high bar for intuitiveness and reducing cognitive load for technical users. Interdisciplinary Collaboration Work closely with AI Researchers and Data Engineers to understand the nuances of their daily tasks and build tools that empower them. Collaborate with the broader engineering team to ensure internal tools align with our overall infrastructure and security standards. Must Have Skills and Qualifications: You have at least 4+ years of professional experience in full-stack software engineering, with a proven track record of building and maintaining production-grade applications. You possess strong backend expertise, specifically with Python and modern web frameworks (e.g. FastAPI, Django, or Flask). You are proficient with Node.js and modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React, Vue, or TypeScript) and have a keen eye for UI/UX best practices. You are a "builder" at heart who enjoys the greenfield stage of a project and is comfortable making architectural decisions from scratch. You have a product-focused mindset, meaning you don't just "write tickets" but actively think about how to make the user's life easier. You are excited by the prospect of enabling world-changing scientific discovery, even if you don't have a background in the sciences yourself. Bonus Points (But Not Critical): Experience working in an early-stage startup environment where you've had to wear multiple hats. Previous experience building internal tools, dashboards, or "Admin" interfaces for data-heavy companies. Knowledge of modern DevOps practices and cloud infrastructure (e.g. GCP, Docker, Kubernetes). An academic background or personal interest in Materials Science, Chemistry, or Sustainability. Additional Considerations This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work. What We Offer A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. title: People Operations Partner
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. 🚀 The Role We're hiring a People Operations Partner to join our Performance team. tem is rebuilding the energy transaction - transparent, fair and built on trust. Behind that mission is a company growing fast, and a Performance team that's already lean and stretched. Core People operations needs more firepower as we scale, and there's a direct commercial angle too: a strong People Operations function is what lets new joiners ramp up and become productive faster once they arrive. This is a multi-disciplinary People Operations role at the centre of the employee lifecycle - equal parts operational delivery, automation and continuous improvement. You'll be the reliable hands keeping People processes running as we scale, from multi-country payroll to onboarding, employee changes and offboarding. You'll also build the tools, automations and lightweight AI workflows that connect our systems (Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n and Google Workspace), so the function doesn't need to double in size every time headcount does. In your first 12 months, you might: Take ownership of payroll across our UK and employer-of-record employees, keeping every cycle accurate and on time as pay schedules and countries multiply. Become the trusted point of contact for employees and managers, owning their queries through to resolution. Build the automations and AI-enabled workflows that remove repetitive manual work from the employee lifecycle. Turn recurring pain points into better processes, tools or self-service, and measure whether they actually worked. Move across People disciplines as priorities shift - reward and benchmarking, pensions and options administration, performance cycles, engagement and people data. 🛠️ Responsibilities Run payroll end to end: own monthly payroll across UK and employer-of-record employees - changes, corrections, off-cycle and ex-gratia payments, contractor payroll and invoicing, and country-specific items - keeping it accurate and on time as we add pay schedules and countries. Keep the lifecycle running: deliver core People operations across onboarding, employee changes, contracts and documentation, leave, mobility (visas and international moves), EOR and contractor setup, and offboarding, flexing into whatever the business needs most. Be the trusted point of contact: own employee and manager queries through to resolution with a clear response standard, rather than passing them between functions. Keep the foundations accurate: maintain employee data, documentation and systems so that everything else can depend on them. Automate the repeatable: build and maintain automations and lightweight AI-enabled tools, workflows and agents that connect Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n, Google Workspace and similar, and remove repetitive manual work - with controls so speed never costs accuracy, privacy or employee trust. Own the People tech stack: evolve our People technology ecosystem - evaluate emerging tools, consolidate where we can, and simplify the architecture. Improve continuously: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, measure whether they worked, and give foundational People processes a named owner and a runbook someone else could follow cold. Design to delight and to scale: we treat our people like top athletes and aim to delight at every step of the employee journey, and what works at today's size shouldn't need twice the People team when headcount doubles - default to eliminating or automating work rather than administering it. Partner across the business: work with Finance, Legal, Talent, Performance Partners and functional specialists to turn People initiatives into scalable services, and build dashboards and lightweight analysis that help the team and the business make better decisions. ✅ Requirements Must-Haves You've worked in People Operations, People Services, HR Operations or another operational People role - generalists welcome - and you hold a high bar on accuracy and confidentiality. You've run payroll cycles end to end, ideally multi-country, in-house or through an employer of record. UK fundamentals (PAYE, RTI, pension auto-enrolment, statutory payments) are familiar, or clearly learnable fast if your payroll experience comes from another market. You're highly comfortable with technology: AI is part of how you work, you actively experiment with new tools and capabilities, and you can build automations through no-code or low-code tools, integrations and AI workflows. You think in systems and workflows rather than individual tasks, with a strong instinct for simplification ("why are we doing this manually?"), and you're comfortable using data to diagnose problems and make decisions. You operate effectively in ambiguity, without waiting for a perfectly defined process or remit, and you balance efficiency with empathy - People Operations is about people, not just workflows. Strong ownership instincts: when something's broken, unclear or inefficient, your instinct is to fix it, and you're willing to move across People disciplines depending on where the organisation needs you. Desirable Breadth across the People remit beyond Operations - reward and benchmarking, pensions, benefits, or performance and engagement. This role is deliberately multi-disciplinary. Familiarity with the basics of UK and EU employment law, and experience administering equity or share options (for example EMI or unapproved schemes, and cap-table tools such as Vestd). Experience supporting international employment through employers of record, and setting up or managing contractors (including off-payroll and IR35 awareness). Experience in a fast-scaling startup or scale-up, especially through a period of doubling headcount or entering new countries. 🎁 Benefits & Perks Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing. 🤝 Interview Process We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders. title: Engineering Manager, Experiment Platform, Robot Software
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model. The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software. 🧠 Your day-to-day You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. You will maintain the team’s mission, charter and twelve-month roadmap, turn them into quarterly and six-week plans, and keep delivery on track. You will be the team’s main point of contact for partner engineering teams, programme managers, operations and OEM customers, and you will make it clear what the team owns. You will stay technically capable and aware of the team’s work across the codebase. You will monitor the architecture, guide the team through technical blockers when needed, and engage with technical leaders in other teams at a technical level. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Growing the platform: Take the development platform from its first stable release to a product used across many vehicle types, with predictable releases and validation in CI and on HIL benches. Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration. Self-serve experimentation: Make the platform self-serve, so research teams can run their own experiments on vehicles without waiting for platform changes. Scaling data collection: Onboard and event-based logging, data quality, and data offload over New vehicles and OEM integrations: Deploy the full platform on Wayve’s next-generation vehicles, and support new OEM integrations through configuration rather than new releases. Building the operating model around the platform: Releases, support rota, on-call, metrics and observability. Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, and grow the team as adoption of the platform expands. 🙌 You should apply if: You have managed software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching and performance management. You have owned a platform or product that other teams or customers relied on, and shipped it to devices in the field. You are technically capable, with hands-on experience in embedded Linux systems software (C++ or Python), and stay close enough to the code to review your team’s work, guide architecture and help resolve technical blockers. You understand connected device fleets, such as vehicles, robots or IoT, including data logging and offload, over-the-air updates and observability. You are comfortable leading delivery across many stakeholders, including external partners, and can engage with other technical leaders as a technical peer. You care about operational reliability and release quality. Experience with autonomous vehicles or robotics, automotive ECUs (for example NVIDIA Jetson or DRIVE, QNX), Yocto, IPC middleware such as ROS 2 or DDS, or containerised workloads on embedded systems is desirable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. This role is based in our London office. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews : leadership and management interview, and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total Deep-dive interviews : domain, systems design and code review interviews; 3 hours total Final interview : values alignment (30-45 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. title: Unix Platform Engineer
description: <p><strong>Department Overview:</strong></p> <p>Our Technology Infrastructure team operates globally and is responsible for every aspect of the firm's hybrid platform. This ranges from our EUC/Office environments to Trading and Core service Co-Location Data Centres, and extends to Public Cloud, delivering top-tier technology services to a dynamic and demanding Trading organisation.<br><br>In addition to meeting the round-the-clock operational demands of the platforms, we continuously evolve and transform our platforms to maintain a competitive edge that our business requires. We innovate to provide valuable solutions and leverage our skilled Technology teams to deliver against rapidly changing business requirements.</p> <p><strong>Role Overview: </strong></p> <p>As a member of our London-based Infrastructure Platform Engineering team, this position encompasses the design, engineering, and support of our multi-tenant private and public cloud initiatives. The role is integral to delivering services to our core business sectors globally, including Trading, middle and back office, and Technology.</p> <p>The role is responsible for the support and maintenance of the BlueCrest Linux estate and Automation Services, delivered via On-Premise, Colo and Public Cloud platforms, providing robust solutions based on leading technologies to enhance and support our business.</p> <p>The role delivers excellent levels of service to the business, requiring an understanding of key business processes and a solid understanding of how the solutions we deliver aid and develop our growing business. The successful candidate will understand and be involved in critical BAU and technology service delivery activities in a time-sensitive environment, whilst being innovative and implementing new solutions to enhance business performance.</p> <p>The successful candidate will follow pre-defined scopes, designs and plans to assist in implementing and supporting new and existing technology initiatives, while demonstrating clear communication skills.</p> <p><strong>Experience required: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive knowledge and experience of a major Linux Enterprise Server distribution including installation, configuration, automation, administration, and support in diverse, highly dynamic, fast-paced environments - desirable: <ul> <li>SUSE Certified Administrator/Engineer (SCA/SCE), Red Hat Certified System Administrator/Engineer (RHCSA/RHCE), or equivalent Linux certification.</li> <li>Experience with container platforms and tooling, including Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, and GitOps, is also desirable.</li> <li>Knowledge of integrating Linux within a Windows environment, including Active Directory and Kerberos integration.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Experience designing and supporting low-latency Unix-based trading systems in exchange colocation data centres.</li> <li>Experience of automating and orchestrating cross-platform services using tools such as Terraform, Terragrunt, and Cloud-Init.</li> <li>Advanced scripting/programming skills in Python and Bash, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and data structures such as JSON and YAML – highly desirable.</li> <li>Experience of server hardware implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and automation using Infrastructure as Code and Ansible, including deployment and support within colocation facilities, low-latency environments, and distributed trading platforms.</li> <li>Experience supporting on-premises infrastructure, integrating it with cloud platforms, and ensuring resilience, performance, and scalability across hybrid environments.</li> <li>Experience with AI/ML workloads, AIOps, and supporting infrastructure would be beneficial.</li> <li>Technology-focused and committed to continuous learning, with the ability to deliver rapidly while balancing business constraints in fast-paced enterprise trading environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate is an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with proven hands-on experience supporting enterprise Linux platforms, with strong expertise in SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) and/or Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL).  The role requires experience integrating hosted and on-premises systems, with a focus on standardisation, automation and orchestration to deliver scalable, reliable infrastructure solutions. Experience supporting cloud platforms and AI/ML workloads would be beneficial.</p> <p>This role would suit an enthusiastic, self-motivated individual who thrives in a pressurised environment and wants to develop their Linux and automation skills and knowledge whilst gaining a detailed understanding of business processes.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>BlueCrest is committed to providing an inclusive environment for its workforce. title: Sales Director, EMEA
description: Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle. At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth. We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary. Sales Director, EMEA This is a senior sales opportunity for an experienced commercial leader to drive Talos’s growth with banks and TradFi institutions as institutional finance moves into digital assets and tokenized, multi-asset trading. As Sales Director at Talos, you will own new business and key relationships across the UK, with a focus on banks and TradFi institutions entering digital assets. You will run the full deal lifecycle, from origination and discovery through solutioning, trials and close, partnering closely with Solutions and Account Management to make sure clients are set up for long-term success. Talos runs a structured, consultative sales environment. This role suits someone with an established TradFi network, a proven record of originating revenue, and the ability to clearly articulate how institutional trading infrastructure is changing. Responsibilities Originate and close new business across banks, broker-dealers and TradFi institutions, alongside Talos’s core client segments including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers and digital asset service providers. Use and expand your network of senior bank and TradFi relationships to build a high-quality pipeline from day one. Lead senior-level discovery and demo conversations, mapping institutional workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities. Position Talos clearly within the evolving digital asset ecosystem, translating TradFi requirements across connectivity, risk, compliance and workflow into Talos’s value proposition. Manage and grow an existing book of business in partnership with Account Management, driving retention, expansion and executive-level relationships. Coordinate cross-functionally with Solutions, Account Management, Product and Engineering to advance deals and make sure client commitments are accurate and deliverable. Capture and communicate client and market insights to inform product roadmap and go-to-market strategy. Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce. Act as a senior Talos presence in the London market, representing Talos at industry conferences and client events. Share expertise and informally mentor junior members of the sales team. Requirements 7+ years of client-facing sales or commercial experience within institutional financial services, fintech or enterprise SaaS serving capital markets. An established network of active relationships across banks and TradFi institutions, particularly in the UK and Europe. A proven track record of originating and closing new business, with quantifiable results. Deep understanding of TradFi market structure and institutional trading workflows. Experience in FX, fixed income, equities or multi-asset trading environments is highly valued. Familiarity with digital assets is advantageous but not required. You should bring genuine interest in how TradFi is adopting digital assets and tokenization. The ability to lead consultative, senior-level sales conversations and explain complex infrastructure in clear, client-friendly terms. Strong commercial judgment, with the discipline to set realistic client expectations and avoid overcommitting on product or timelines. A self-directed, high-ownership approach: you can build a pipeline and maintain momentum independently, without ramp-up or close guidance. A collaborative, team-first mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced, distributed environment with a high degree of autonomy. Based in London, or able to work from the London office. Our Sales Approach Talos operates a systematic, consultative sales process built around a simple principle: listen first, sell second . We take the time to understand a client's workflows, constraints, and goals before positioning a solution. We sell what we have - with deep product mastery and honest conversations about what's on the roadmap and what isn't. We maintain a balanced pipeline across focus segments, use Salesforce rigorously to track progress, and hand off every closed deal with a documented account plan so the relationship starts on solid footing from day one. We play the long game. Underpromise, overdeliver, and build the kind of relationships that compound over time. More about Talos Check out these videos and links to learn more about Talos and our culture! Spotlight Article: Talos Snapshot by DRW Podcast: 2023 episode with co-founders Anton & Ethan Website: Explore Talos: Products, Investors, Team & More Case Studies: Real world examples of client solutions Awards: Talos Wins Hedgeweek Global Digital Assets Award 2024 Culture: Award-winning, Forbes-listed, low-attrition team Andreessen Horowitz re: Talos: "The company best suited to drive institutional adoption is one that understands traditional capital markets deeply and is forward-thinking enough to fully grasp the promise of crypto. Talos is that company." Benefits You will also enjoy a comprehensive array of competitive benefits, regardless of your location, within our warm, welcoming, and ambitious company culture. Some of our benefits include: Retirement plan contributions Unlimited Vacation + a PTO bonus: Employees that take 15 days of vacation, with 5 days being consecutive, receive a $2000 USD bonus. Bonus and stock ownership Medical, dental, and vision insurance Paid parental leave for 20 weeks, after 1 year of service Global offsites and team outings A one-time stipend towards at-home office set-up for all employees A wellness credit of $50 accrued monthly, to go towards things like gym memberships, ski-passes, and work out classes. A lunch credit of $25 USD towards lunches for days in-office Donation matching up to $100 USD annually Other in-office perks: Catered lunches on Tuesdays, snacks, and drinks Talos is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. title: Head of Brand and Creative
description: Head of Brand and Creative The Role The UK is Lyrebird's most important new market, and you'll own how we show up in it. You'll co-develop Lyrebird's brand strategy and lead its rollout across the UK, covering media, communications, campaigns, research, partnerships, agency and budget management, and the brand measurement that proves it's working. You'll also own the creative bar for everything Lyrebird makes globally. That means the taste and quality of the work, plus the operations, agencies and systems that let in-house and external teams produce world-class creative at pace. This is a senior leadership hire at a foundational moment: you'll shape how Lyrebird looks, sounds and feels as it scales. This role suits someone who moves easily between thinking about the brand and the category and caring about the quality of a single frame. You'll enjoy setting strategy in one meeting and art-directing in the next. You get as much energy from building the system behind great work as from making it, and you can hold a room of executives as comfortably as a room of creatives. If you want real influence over business outcomes and a brand you can call your own, you'll feel at home here. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians' most time-consuming tasks. We're building the medical intelligence layer for modern healthcare: a clinical AI platform that combines ambient real-time documentation, intelligent document management, clinical workflow automation, native patient data integrations across siloed health systems, and a communications layer that keeps clinicians and patients connected. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. We give clinicians richer patient information at the right moment and lighten their mental load during consults, so they can focus on delivering better care. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale. What you'll do Co-own Lyrebird's brand strategy and lead its UK rollout. This covers positioning, media, communications and campaigns that grow brand preference and trust among UK clinicians and healthcare professionals. Set and hold the creative quality and taste bar for everything Lyrebird makes globally, whether it's made in-house or by agencies. Build the creative engine: the operations, workflows, playbooks and systems that let in-house and external teams produce world-class work at volume and pace. Select, brief and manage creative and media agencies to a high standard, and decide what we build in-house and what we outsource. Design and own a brand measurement framework for a clinical audience, and report on brand health against clear goals. Shape the research and partnerships agenda that helps build the medical AI category the right way. Work closely with growth, retention, product marketing, our clinical team, product and engineering, analytics, sales, customer success and our founders, so the brand holds together across every touchpoint. What you'll bring Senior experience leading brand strategy and creative output, either at an agency or in-house at a growth-stage company, and a body of work you're proud of. A high creative bar. You set the standard, art-direct, and give sharp direction that lifts the quality of a team's work. Operational brand media depth: planning, buying and optimising integrated campaigns across digital, OOH, streaming audio, social, professional media partnerships, conference sponsorships and sponsored content. Creative operations and agency leadership. You've built the systems and managed the partners that let great work ship at pace. An audience-first instinct backed by analytical rigour. You turn insight about a professional audience into positioning, media and creative that resonate, and you're comfortable with brand measurement, including brand lift and incrementality. Strong leadership and communication, and an AI-native approach. You build and develop talent, and you use AI across creative development, planning, research and reporting. Nice to have Familiarity with healthcare or medical audience channels, such as medical associations, clinical publications and conference media. Experience in the UK or NHS healthcare market. Comfort with dashboards and marketing measurement tools such as Tableau, Sigma or Looker, and with marketing mix modelling or incrementality studies. The work you do here will shape how clinicians first come to know and trust Lyrebird, and that trust is what lets them bring it into the care they give. The stronger the brand and the work, the more clinicians reach for Lyrebird, and the more patients feel the difference. We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you're from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Accounts Payable Associate
description: LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South. Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live. What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth. With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity. About the role LemFi is the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve - powering cross-border payments, multi-currency accounts, savings, and credit across 21 countries. Our Finance team sits at the centre of all of it, and the AP function is what keeps the engine running cleanly behind the scenes. As an Accounts Payable Associate you'll own the end-to-end processing of vendor payments across our UK, US, Canada, Ireland, Norway, Nigeria, and other entities - working across multiple currencies, GL codes, tax jurisdictions, and approval chains. You'll work closely with the wider Finance, Growth, and Operations teams, and you'll have real scope to improve the processes you inherit, not just execute them. What you'll build and own Process and control vendor invoices across multiple entities and currencies in Tipalti and NetSuite - accurately, on time, every time Perform first-line GL coding, cost-centre allocation, and tax coding (VAT, reverse charge, RCS), flagging anomalies before they become problems Run and support payment cycles - validating bank details, currency, and approval sign-off - and manage the AP inbox with clear, prompt communication to vendors and internal stakeholders Own the monthly AP close: accruals, aged payables review, and reconciliations, with discrepancies surfaced and resolved, not buried Maintain vendor master data (bank details, tax status, W-9/W-8 forms) with tight controls, and support audit requests with clean, well-organised evidence Spot recurring miscoding, duplicate invoices, and process gaps - then help fix them, contributing to automation initiatives (including n8n workflows and NetSuite automation) that reduce manual effort for the whole team Support bank statement uploads and reconciliations for the Reporting team, ensuring transactions post correctly and discrepancies are flagged fast Your experience 1-3 years in an Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, or transactional finance role Hands-on experience with an AP or ERP system; NetSuite and/or Tipalti strongly preferred Comfortable processing across multiple currencies and entities; exposure to a multi-jurisdiction or group structure is a real advantage Working knowledge of VAT and sales tax concepts - reverse charge, non-deductible VAT, or equivalent Strong Excel skills: lookups, pivot tables, data cleanup, and reconciliation work Detail-oriented and control-conscious, with the ability to prioritise a high volume of transactions and meet payment deadlines without dropping the ball Clear written communicator who can liaise confidently with vendors and internal stakeholders Nice to have Experience in a fintech, payments, or regulated financial services environment Exposure to automation tools (e.g. n8n) or light scripting for finance workflows Experience supporting external audit requests (KPMG, Crowe, BKL, or similar) Why Join LemFi? Love shouldn’t be expensive, yet those working hardest for their families often face predatory fees and banking exclusion. We're changing this. At LemFi, you won’t be just a cog in a machine. Whether designing products, scaling operations, or telling our story, you’ll tackle complex challenges with real, immediate impact. Your work goes beyond metrics - it puts money back in families’ pockets and offers access to the previously excluded. Join us to make a meaningful difference, where high performance is a lifeline for millions. You can connect with us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play . Recruitment Agencies Notice LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee. title: Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer, Apps Platform
description: <p>Senior Infrastructure Software Engineer, Apps Platform, London</p> <p> </p> <p>As an Infrastructure Engineer on the Apps Platform Infrastructure team, you'll help build and evolve our platform’s deployment and observability layers across multiple cloud providers and on-premises, for both internal and customer-managed environments. This is a role for someone who cares about building cloud-agnostic infrastructure and deployment pipelines.</p> <p>You'll partner closely with internal teams to understand how they use and deploy the platform, debug their issues, and shape a roadmap that balances immediate needs with long-term architecture.</p> <h3>You will:</h3> <ul> <li>Expand the deployment footprint of our platform to cover both on-premise, all major cloud platforms and beyond</li> <li>Ensure fast, secure, and reproducible deployments across all supported CSPs and on-prem  </li> <li>Expand the observability of the platform so that forward deployed infrastructure teams can easily and efficiently operate customer deployments</li> <li>Partner closely with internal teams deploying the platform to understand their needs, debug issues, and build tooling that serves their use cases</li> <li>Respond to incidents and production issues with urgency, conducting root cause analysis and implementing preventive fixes</li> <li>Help develop and maintain a product roadmap for deployment and observability</li> <li>Lead architecture reviews and own projects end-to-end, from design through deployment, in fast-paced cross-functional settings</li> </ul> <h3>Ideally you'd have:</h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience building and deploying enterprise and public sector solutions across AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI and on-premises</li> <li>Deep expertise in infrastructure design, networking engineering, VPNs, load balancers, and firewalls</li> <li>Deep proficiency with IaC, containerisation and orchestration tools and technologies (Kubernetes, Terraform, Docker)</li> <li>Comprehensive understanding of CI/CD pipelines and software delivery principles using GitHub Actions or CircleCI.</li> <li>Experience with GitOps-style deployments and a track record of ensuring consistent, repeatable deployments</li> <li>Strong debugging skills and the ability to navigate performance/security tradeoffs in production systems</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to context-switch between reactive incident work and proactive product development</li> </ul> <h3>Nice to haves:</h3> <ul> <li>Experience as a founder or early engineer at an infrastructure-focused startup, owning a product end-to-end</li> <li>Experience running secure workloads in multi-tenant or untrusted environments (e.g., FaaS, CI sandboxes, remote notebooks)</li> <li>Open-source contributions to systems or developer-tools projects</li> <li>History of on-call/incident response for production systems</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong><em>PLEASE NOTE: </em></strong><em>Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants.</em></p> <p><strong>About Us:</strong></p> <p><em>At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications.</em></p> <p><em>We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. </em></p> <p><em>We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. title: Data and AI Engineer Director | Market Lead
description: <div class="description content"> <p><strong>Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI</strong></p> <br> <p><strong>Data and AI Engineer (Market Lead), UKI</strong> · Director level · London preferred</p> <p>We are looking for a Director-level Market Lead to head our Data & AI practice in the UK & Ireland. This is a hybrid leadership role. You combine deep technical solutioning with real commercial skill, and you are credible both in an architecture debate and across the table from a CDO, CIO or CFO.</p> <p> Our delivery model is shifting from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first pods working against a business outcome. As Market Lead, you will shape how we take that model to UKI clients: what we sell, how we price it, and how we staff and deliver it. You will lead a core team of 5–6 direct reports and a wider matrix of around 50-75 people across UKI, and you will help them build the skills this shift requires. We are developing these ways of working together.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Main focus and responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Commercial and solutioning</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive commercial success on complex Data & AI deals across UKI, from shaping the opportunity through to a signed deal. This includes structuring fixed-price and outcome-linked commercial models, and understanding delivery cost, margin and risk.</li> <li>Partner with tech advisory and industry domain leads from pre-sale through delivery, so the commercial story, the architecture and the sector insight reinforce one another.</li> <li>Frame and test business-outcome hypotheses with executives, and define thin slices of delivery that prove value quickly.</li> <li>You stay close enough to delivery to know what is realistic, and you share accountability for outcomes on the deals you sell.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Practice leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Spearhead growth of the UKI Data & AI practice: build, lead, scale and mentor a high-performing team.</li> <li>Work with delivery and talent leads to match demand with capacity, so the right people and pods are available when deals land. Keep specialist skills sourced and bench waste low.</li> <li>Shift the practice's capability mix towards production AI engineering and agentic delivery, through hiring, reskilling and role-based onboarding.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Manage executive-level relationships with CDOs, CIOs, CISOs and other CXOs. Act as a sparring partner on AI strategy: challenge assumptions, size the opportunity, and help clients decide where agentic automation and AI can move the P&L.</li> <li>Build and manage robust sales pipelines and lead strategic client workshops.</li> <li>Advise clients on responsible AI, covering risk, governance and regulatory expectations in the UK and wider markets.</li> <li>Expected to lead and drive P&L with TCV of 50 -75 M GBP and ACV of 45-50 M GBP/</li> <li>Expected experience and capabilities in driving all P&L criterias including sales, margin, utilization, bench management, training, learning, partnership based sales etc.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>I</strong><strong>deal candidate profile</strong></p> <p>The successful candidate is a true dual-threat practitioner, equally at home in a complex architecture discussion and in closing a large commercial deal.</p> <br> <table> <tbody> <tr> <td> <p><strong>Criterion</strong></p> </td> <td> <p><strong>Requirement</strong></p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Experience</p> </td> <td> <p>Significant senior experience in data and AI consulting, typically 15+ years, with a track record in leadership roles. You are neither a pure solution architect nor a pure sales profile.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Commercial track record</p> </td> <td> <p>History of selling multiple large-scale data and AI deals, ideally including recent GenAI or agentic engagements, and able to discuss deal shape, pricing structure, trade-offs and delivery and business value delivery in concrete terms.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Technical expertise</p> </td> <td> <p>Strong solutioning background in complex ecosystems: data platforms and data products, data governance, and AI systems in production, including agentic and LLM-based systems. You understand failure modes, evaluation, cost and risk, not just architecture diagrams.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Data/AI balance</p> </td> <td> <p>Roughly 70/30, with demonstrable recent depth in AI (last 2–4 years), for example AI agents, AI advisory or AI foundations with large UK clients. Data depth is the foundation, but hand on AI credibility is required.</p> </td> </tr> <tr> <td> <p>Tech stack</p> </td> <td> <p>Strong cloud proficiency in at least one major platform (GCP, AWS or Azure). At our scale, even incremental improvements can have a significant commercial impact. Experience working within an in-house e-commerce team is essential. We will not consider candidates whose Google Ads background is primarily in agency, consultancy, or freelance work. We are seeking someone who has owned performance from inside an e-commerce business, where success is assessed through revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and sustainable growth. You should be ready to take responsibility for commercial outcomes and implement your own decisions, with involvement that extends beyond providing recommendations or delivering campaigns. What we are looking for: A minimum of 2 years of practical experience managing Google Ads campaigns A track record of owning Google Ads performance within an e-commerce business, with direct accountability for results and profitability Thorough working knowledge of Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns Proven experience as part of an in-house e-commerce team Confidence working with large datasets and extracting insights that inform practical action A sound understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center Strong analytical thinking and careful attention to detail Fluent written and spoken English The ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced setting where priorities can change An inquisitive, proactive mindset and a consistent focus on improvement The confidence to make decisions independently and accept responsibility for the results An openness to using AI and automation as we continue expanding their application across the business Availability to join immediately or at the earliest possible opportunity How you approach your work: You combine senior-level judgment with a practical approach to execution. Your decisions are grounded in data, and you know how to translate analysis into concrete steps. You actively look for opportunities to improve, remain curious about what drives performance, and keep commercial outcomes in focus. You are comfortable moving between strategic planning and daily campaign management, with a strong motivation to build and scale. Location and travel: We are investing further in London and anticipate that it will play a growing role as one of our business hubs. Our broader team is based across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. You will also travel approximately every 4–8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, or other team locations. These trips bring colleagues together for planning, workshops, team events, and strategic discussions. As we grow, we continue to value regular time together in person alongside the flexibility of remote work. Our culture: At ennovationHUB, we value: Taking ownership and being accountable for outcomes Putting ideas into practice Communicating clearly and directly Developing knowledge through hands-on experience We welcome colleagues from a wide range of backgrounds who take pride in their work, accept responsibility, and want to help the business move forward. This is a long-term opportunity to play a meaningful part in the continued growth of an international e-commerce group. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><h2><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></h2> <p>CoreWeave’s Global Tax Team’s mission is to mitigate risk, drive operational efficiencies, and add financial value by combining technical expertise with a proactive, collaborative approach to global taxation. We are seeking a Senior Manager, International Tax Operations, to join our team. This role will be crucial in managing international tax operations, including income tax compliance and provision. It is a unique opportunity to share and influence global tax strategies at a rapidly growing technology company.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>Within our AI native Tax Department, this high-impact London-based role offers significant opportunities. You will play a part in influencing our global tax strategy and operations across EMEA and APAC. Reporting to the Director of Tax Operations, you will manage international tax matters in a fast-paced regulatory and business environment. You will partner with the Global Tax team (direct tax operations, advisory and controversy, indirect tax), Controllership and business operations counterparts, and external advisors to ensure compliance and deliver the company’s direct tax compliance and reporting.</p> <ul> <li>Compliance and provision</li> <ul> <li>Manage non-US direct tax filings prepared by internal teams and external advisors, including matters related to Pillar 2</li> <li>Advising on local income tax compliance and other reporting obligation matters including DAC 6, anti-hybrid regulations, CbCr, etc. </li> <li>Partner with Controllership in the preparation of statutory financial statements, including the calculation of statutory tax provisions and advise on income tax reporting </li> <li>Enhancing internal controls to ensure accurate accounting for income taxes</li> <li>Building up and liaising with external tax service providers and external auditors in the region on our co-sourcing engagement across tax and statutorily financial statements</li> <li>Co-lead with Director of Tax Operations the build out of APAC provision and compliance processes in 2027, whilst remaining focused on the expansion of EMEA</li> <li>Partnering with indirect tax team on various matters including entity expansion, and indirect tax impacts of intercompany transactions</li> <li>Partner with Treasury to support global cash management</li> <li>Develop and leverage AI tools to enhance and streamline income tax reporting and provision processes</li> </ul> </ul> <ul> <li>Advisory Support</li> <ul> <li>Support local management in the integration of M&A targets into CoreWeave</li> <li>Provide support and management of ex-US income tax controversy</li> <li>Look for tax opportunities via our co-sourcing relationships (i.e. non-US R&D credits, withholding tax relief, etc.) </li> <li>Stay abreast of international and OECD legislative and statutory tax changes that may impact  CoreWeaveProvide guidance on international tax topics </li> </ul> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li>ACA, CA, CTA, ACCA or comparable corporate tax and accounting knowledge  </li> <li>10+ years of progressive corporate tax experience in public accounting and multinational companies.</li> <li>Solid technical tax knowledge across EMEA and APAC.</li> <li>Experience in managing global projects</li> <li>Strong leadership, analytical, and communication skills with executive presence.</li> <ul> <li>Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities</li> <li>Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills</li> </ul> <li>Interest in building with new technology and automation</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you’re a good fit?</strong> </p> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we’ve found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we’d love to talk. </p> <ul> <li>You love to understand the “why” behind business operations</li> <li>You’re curious about tax regulations and their business implications and expanding your knowledge of tax developments</li> <li>You’re an expert in translating complex tax concepts into actionable business guidance</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></h3> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast! We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Curious at Your Core</strong></li> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner</strong><strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Empower Employees</strong><strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</strong><strong><br></strong></li> <li><strong>Achieve More Together</strong></li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and provides the opportunity to develop innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the growth opportunities within the organization are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us!</p> <p>The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. All qualified applicants and candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.</em></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Recruitment Agencies</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em><em data-stringify-type="italic">CoreWeave does not accept speculative CVs. title: Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. </strong></p> <p><strong>We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. </strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.</strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. </strong><br><strong> </strong><br><strong>For more information, visit <a href="https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=http%3A%2F%2Fwpp.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7CErica.Durr%40wpp.com%7C9bf4566a65bc46a48ac008de749116ea%7C150b5e663d884dee83f6ed149b727a00%7C0%7C0%7C639076363668176216%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Q9juosud56XGLThSFZ1NpPZd6FXpJPxV74OeRZWoh%2B4%3D&reserved=0" target="_blank">WPP.com.</a></strong><br><strong> </strong></p></div><h1>About WPP</h1> <p>WPP is the creative transformation company. Through One WPP and the Elevate28 transformation agenda, we are building a simpler, more integrated, agile and AI-powered enterprise. WPP’s Performance & Culture Center of Excellence brings together the capabilities that help our people, teams and organisation perform, grow and thrive. Within it, Enterprise Effectiveness aligns WPP’s organisation, workforce and teams around its strategic priorities and enables the change required to deliver them.</p> <h1>About the Role</h1> <p>The Workforce Intelligence & Analytics Manager is a contract role that will build the evidence base for the workforce and organisation decisions that matter most to WPP. This role will turn fragmented people, organisation and business data into clear insight, forward-looking scenarios and practical recommendations that help leaders decide where to invest, how to shape the workforce and how to organise for performance.</p> <p>Reporting to the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, you will support the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence while working closely with business, People & Culture, Finance, Data and Technology partners. You will establish a trusted workforce-intelligence capability that supports strategic workforce planning and informs priority organisation, workforce, team and people decisions across Enterprise Effectiveness and the wider Performance & Culture Center of Excellence. This is not a traditional reporting role. It combines strategic analytics, internal consulting and leadership of a four-person data and reporting team based in India. You will be expected to work through ambiguity, connect disparate data and systems, and progressively turn fragmented analytics into a more integrated, trusted and usable capability. As a contract appointment, the initial focus will be to establish the core workforce-intelligence approach, strengthen the India-based team and deliver insight against WPP’s highest-priority workforce and organisation questions.</p> <h1>Why This Role Matters</h1> <p>WPP’s transformation requires faster, better choices about work, skills, capacity, organisation and investment. Those choices cannot be made from disconnected dashboards or backward-looking metrics alone. In this role, you will create a more integrated view of the workforce, translate evidence into choices and trade-offs, and help leaders anticipate the implications of AI, changing client demand and new ways of working. The work will directly shape how WPP builds the capabilities, capacity and organisation required for Elevate28.</p> <h1>What You’ll Do</h1> <h2>Build a trusted workforce intelligence capability</h2> <ul> <li>Working with the Global Head of Enterprise Effectiveness, shape and build an enterprise workforce-intelligence approach that connects people, organisation and business data to the decisions leaders need to make.</li> <li>Define a focused set of workforce and organisational measures, dashboards and decision-support tools, moving reporting from activity and headcount toward capacity, capability, cost, productivity, risk and value.</li> <li>Partner with data owners and technology teams to map fragmented data and systems, define analytical requirements, and strengthen data definitions, quality, accessibility and responsible use, while being clear about limitations and the strength of the evidence.</li> <li>Establish repeatable analytical standards, governance and quality controls so insight is trusted, comparable and usable across WPP.</li> <li>Apply AI and automation to improve how workforce data is integrated, analysed and translated into decision support, while maintaining appropriate human judgement, transparency and responsible-use standards.</li> </ul> <h2>Enable strategic workforce planning</h2> <ul> <li>Help business and People & Culture leaders translate strategy, growth priorities and choices about how work is organised into workforce demand, capability and capacity requirements.</li> <li>Build scenarios that show the implications of different choices, including developing, hiring, accessing external capability, automating, augmenting, redeploying and exiting work or roles.</li> <li>Assess the current workforce and future talent supply, including critical skills, capacity, cost, location and role mix, highlighting gaps, risks and investment priorities.</li> <li>Connect workforce planning to business and financial planning cycles so decisions are timely, owned and grounded in common assumptions.</li> </ul> <h2>Deliver forward-looking insight and decision support</h2> <ul> <li>Use statistical analysis, forecasting and scenario modelling to identify emerging workforce and organisational risks, opportunities and patterns.</li> <li>Bring structure to ambiguous business questions, identify what can be answered with available data, test hypotheses and distinguish meaningful signals from correlation or noise.</li> <li>Turn analysis into clear choices, trade-offs and recommendations for senior leaders, including the consequences of action and inaction.</li> <li>Develop concise executive narratives and visualisations that make complex findings understandable without oversimplifying them.</li> </ul> <h2>Strengthen organisation and transformation decisions</h2> <ul> <li>Provide analytical support for organisation design, organisational health, inclusion and impact, talent development, team effectiveness and change priorities across Performance and Culture.</li> <li>Create baselines and evaluate whether organisation and workforce interventions are improving the intended outcomes.</li> <li>Combine quantitative evidence with qualitative insight to explain not only what is happening, but why it matters and where targeted action is needed.</li> <li>Identify enterprise patterns across businesses, markets and functions and convert them into practical recommendations for leaders and Enterprise Effectiveness partners.</li> </ul> <h2>Scale tools, capability and adoption</h2> <ul> <li>Build practical tools, templates and self-service products that improve the quality and consistency of workforce decisions.</li> <li>Coach People & Culture and business partners to interpret workforce insight, challenge assumptions and use scenarios in decision-making.</li> <li>Create a clear intake and prioritisation approach that focuses analytical capacity on the highest-value enterprise questions.</li> <li>Continuously improve the offer through user feedback, adoption evidence and emerging practice in workforce analytics, AI and organisational science.</li> <li>Lead and develop a four-person data and reporting team based in India, setting clear priorities, strengthening analytical and consulting capability, and shifting delivery from fragmented reporting toward higher-value workforce intelligence and decision support.</li> </ul> <h1>Minimum Qualifications</h1> <ul> <li>Relevant experience applying data and analytics in finance, commercial, operational or other business settings, together with experience in people analytics, workforce intelligence or strategic workforce planning.</li> <li>Experience translating business questions into analytical approaches, workforce scenarios and decision-ready recommendations.</li> <li>Strong capability in data analysis, forecasting, modelling and visualisation, using appropriate business intelligence or analytical tools.</li> <li>Proven experience working through ambiguity and improving a fragmented data and analytics environment by connecting disparate sources and systems, strengthening definitions and quality, and establishing practical governance, privacy and ethical standards.</li> <li>Ability to communicate complex findings clearly and influence senior stakeholders in a complex organisation.</li> <li>AI fluency, including a practical understanding of how AI and automation can improve analytics, workforce planning and decision support, and how they may reshape work, skills, roles and workforce requirements.</li> <li>Experience leading and developing an analytics or reporting team, including setting priorities, assuring quality and building capability across locations.</li> <li>A degree in a relevant discipline or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <h1>Preferred Experience</h1> <ul> <li>Experience applying financial, commercial or operational analysis to workforce investment, capacity, productivity or organisation decisions.</li> <li>Experience in a complex global, matrixed or multi-business organisation, ideally supporting enterprise transformation or significant workforce change.</li> <li>Proficiency with relevant business intelligence, data-visualisation or analytical tools, which may include Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python or R.</li> <li>Postgraduate study or relevant professional qualifications in analytics, finance, strategic workforce planning or a related field.</li> </ul> <h1>What Success Looks Like</h1> <ul> <li>A clear enterprise workforce-intelligence proposition focused on the workforce and organisation decisions most critical to One WPP and Elevate28.</li> <li>A more integrated and trusted data foundation, with common definitions, practical governance and decision-support tools that connect workforce, organisation, business and financial insight.</li> <li>Workforce plans, scenarios and recommendations that materially improve decisions about skills, capacity, location, cost, AI and automation, technology and workforce shape.</li&

description: <p><strong>Location:</strong> Bristol, UK<br><strong>Salary: </strong>£2500 per month<br><strong>Start date: </strong>June 2027<br><strong>Application deadline</strong>: Midnight, 29th November 2026 <br><em>We encourage you to apply early, as we may close applications before the advertised deadline.</em></p> <h3>The Internship Programme at Graphcore</h3> <p>Explore a career at Graphcore through a 12-week summer internship, gaining hands-on experience on real projects. You’ll bring fresh ideas, put your learning into practice and help shape what we’re creating. Along the way, you’ll tackle challenging problems with a team who welcome your questions and support you as you build your skills and confidence.</p> <h3>What you’ll work on</h3> <p>Use your programming skills and curiosity to help AI models run efficiently on next-generation Graphcore hardware. </p> <p>In AI Compute Libraries & Performance, you’ll contribute to C++ libraries and compute kernels for machine learning workloads. Your work will include: </p> <ul> <li><strong>Developing compute kernels:</strong> Implement and improve operations such as matrix multiplication (GEMM), convolutions, reductions, elementwise operations and fused kernels that combine multiple operations. </li> <li><strong>Understanding and improving performance:</strong> Use profiling and microbenchmarks to measure execution speed and investigate how threading, cache locality, memory layout and kernel launch efficiency affect performance. </li> <li><strong>Checking correctness and reliability:</strong> Build regression tests and numerical checks, investigate issues and improve the quality of the libraries our customers use. </li> </ul> <p>Through these projects, you’ll develop practical experience connecting numerical computing with how code runs on hardware, helping deliver software that is fast, accurate and reliable. </p> <h3>Your team and support</h3> <p>You’ll join a team building high-performance compute libraries that help customers get more from Graphcore hardware. Our work brings together machine learning, numerical computing and accelerator performance, with colleagues sharing their expertise to solve engineering problems.</p> <p><span data-contrast="none">You’ll contribute to clearly scoped projects and build your skills with guidance from engineers working in performance and low-level software. As you take on more responsibility, your colleagues will help you work through challenges, and your ideas will be listened to and discussed respectfully.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559738":240,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <h3>How you’ll learn and grow</h3> <p>Over the 12 weeks, you’ll build performance engineering skills through hands-on work on compute kernels, benchmarks and tests.<span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Profiling and experiments will help you understand where time is spent and how changes to code and data layout affect performance. These are additional strengths, rather than essential requirements.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Flexible working:</strong> Find a balance between your internship and life outside work</li> <li><strong>5 days of annual leave:</strong> Take time to rest and recharge during your 12-week internship</li> <li><strong>Life in the office:</strong> Get to know your colleagues in spaces designed for collaboration, with free food, a great selection of ice cream and an on-site barista</li> <li><strong>Learning and development:</strong> Build your skills and explore your interests with access to O’Reilly, our online learning platform</li> </ul> <p>We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.</p> <p>We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives.
